power_type.myriad_realm.qi.desc: The energy of the Myriad Realm. A Qi cultivator starts as an ordinary mortal (every attribute 1) and grows through training, Qi and the cultivation path. Body is your only life.
class.myriad_realm.spirit_cultivator.des: Excels in Qi: stronger Qi power, pool and defense, weaker body and fists.
class.myriad_realm.body_cultivator.desc: Tempers the flesh: stronger fists, body and stamina, weaker Qi.
attribute.myriad_realm.dexterity.desc: Raises Defense and the Qi Surge speed.
attribute.myriad_realm.mind.desc: Reserved by learned skills and raises the TP you earn.
skill.myriad_realm.qi_meditation.desc: While charging, Qi refills by 0.5 % of its maximum per second and level, paid with Stamina.
